purpose: Bring combined ENABLED daily budgets under the permanent account ceiling so the two paused heating campaigns can later be enabled without breaching it.

budgets.campaign: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Installation | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
budgets.rationale: Best conversion volume in the account and the only campaign whose CPA improved into September ($242.35). Actual settled September delivery is $45.44/day, so $95.00 still leaves roughly 2x headroom over real spend. Largest single reduction in dollars without touching delivery.

budgets.campaign: Search | NonBrand | AC Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
budgets.rationale: Deepest cut, on three independent signals: worst CPA in the account ($637.65 August, $534.28 September), the most expensive clicks by far ($106+ CPC in both windows), and Central Maryland cooling demand falls through the autumn. NOT eliminated - it keeps enough budget for roughly one click per day at the observed clearing price.

budgets.campaign: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
budgets.rationale: Protected almost intact. Best CPA of any campaign ($277.53 August on 6 conversions) and year-round repair demand. Actual September delivery is $17.92/day, so $70.00 is already generous; this is the smallest proportional cut on purpose.

budgets.campaign: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Replacement | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
budgets.rationale: Zero September delivery and zero conversions across both windows. Small cut only, because replacement jobs carry high ticket value and the campaign should stay reachable when demand returns.

budgets.campaign: Search | NonBrand | Gas Boiler Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
budgets.rationale: The only INCREASE. It is the one enabled heating-adjacent campaign and Maryland boiler demand starts now. $5.00/day cannot buy a single click at this account's prices, which is why it has spent $0.00 all season.
